claim: A flagship guide should not compete with the commercial projects archive.
limitation: The site already separates projects, guides, tools and professionals.

claim: Two Tel Aviv naming variants may indicate a taxonomy or canonical issue.
limitation: Only a public symptom was observed; cause is unknown without WordPress, crawl and Search Console.

claim: Israeli building regulation distinguishes goals, functional requirements and prescriptive rules.
limitation: Latest binding text must be checked on publication date.

claim: A project permit and public planning records must be checked for site-specific rights and constraints.
limitation: Public systems do not replace professional review of the project file.

claim: Commissioning verifies a building and its systems against Owner Project Requirements from early design through warranty.
limitation: Not a statutory Israeli requirement unless incorporated into project documents.

claim: Building enclosure commissioning should begin early and include field observation and verification testing.
limitation: Guideline is older and must be adapted to project context.

claim: Facility management should be planned as a strategic, tactical and operational management system.
limitation: ISO 41001 is under revision in 2026.

claim: Maintenance engineering should influence design decisions, access and replacement planning.
limitation: Not Israeli law.

claim: Lift design includes traffic performance, human factors, operation, maintenance and modernization, not only rated speed.
limitation: Project design must comply with current Israeli requirements.

claim: Indoor pool air handling must bring fresh air across the water surface and exhaust chloramine-polluted air.
limitation: Exact design values and Israeli health requirements need local verification.

claim: A dehumidification system alone does not necessarily supply enough fresh air or remove chloramine-polluted air.
limitation: Do not convert into an Israeli prescriptive value without local sources.

claim: BACnet product certification can reduce integration risk but does not replace full system design and commissioning.
limitation: Industry association source.

claim: Natural stone selection requires tests matched to the use and exposure rather than a prestigious quarry name alone.
limitation: Local labs, standards and installation systems require separate verification.

claim: A slender tower may require a tuned mass or liquid damper for occupant comfort.
limitation: Need wind engineer and project-specific criteria.

claim: Mixed hotel-residential towers require deliberate separation or allocation of systems, controls and operating costs.
limitation: Design source, no independent operational audit.

claim: Plumbing layout and acoustic treatment can prevent water-flow noise from disturbing residences below.
limitation: Do not claim a universal performance value.

claim: Waste heat from cooling equipment can be reused for pool heating when system conditions support it.
limitation: Project-specific feasibility and economics required.

claim: Vegetation on a residential façade can require centralized specialist maintenance and remote irrigation.
limitation: Costs and local climate adaptation require project-specific study.

claim: Separate service cores can protect privacy and make staff and deliveries less visible.
limitation: Not the only valid planning solution.

claim: A luxury amenities list is incomplete without capacity, staffing, access, plant space, cleaning and renewal planning.
limitation: Analytical synthesis, not a statutory rule.

claim: A material passport should record product identity, source, finish, batch, installation, cleaning, warranty and spare stock.
limitation: Not a universal legal requirement.

claim: Large equipment should have a replacement path that does not require destroying finished spaces.
limitation: Specific access depends on design and equipment.

claim: A buyer cannot validate building performance from a sales brochure alone.
limitation: Requires project documents and qualified review for a specific purchase.

claim: The project’s first-year service budget should be tested against the promised staffing and amenities.
limitation: Exact budget values are project-specific and time-sensitive.

claim: All current Israeli legal, standard and safety statements must be rechecked on the day of final editing.
limitation: Mandatory editorial gate.
